subject.title: [Feature]: Automatically install brew if not installed

question: Should OpenClaw skill setup ever execute a Homebrew bootstrapper when brew is missing, and if so under what explicit-consent and platform policy?
rationale: The request changes a displayed setup command into package-manager bootstrap execution, which affects security posture and first-run UX beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep manual default
options.body: Preserve the current behavior of showing or grouping manual Homebrew prerequisites while improving copy or skill metadata where needed.

options.title: Add explicit bootstrap
options.body: Allow Homebrew installation only after a clear opt-in prompt with approved source, platform/container rules, logging, timeout, and failure handling.

options.title: Prefer native alternatives
options.body: Avoid Homebrew bootstrap and improve skill metadata, native package fallbacks, or plugin/ClawHub guidance for affected skills.

recommendation.title: Keep manual default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current behavior of showing or grouping manual Homebrew prerequisites while improving copy or skill metadata where needed.

likelyOwner.reason: The current policy-bearing prompt/docs lines are carried by steipete and the decision spans setup security and product UX.
